description: Defines classes and methods for asynchronous disk cache I/O operations in the net::disk_cache::blockfile namespace, including BackendIO and InFlightBackendIO, with proxying of various cache operations.

classes.name: BackendIO
classes.description: Represents a single asynchronous disk cache I/O operation, capable of executing various cache operations and managing callbacks.

classes.name: InFlightBackendIO
classes.description: Manages multiple concurrent BackendIO operations, proxying cache operations, and tracking their state.

methods.name: BackendIO::ExecuteOperation
methods.description: Runs the actual cache operation on a background thread.

methods.name: BackendIO::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of an I/O operation.

methods.name: BackendIO::OnDone
methods.description: Finalizes the operation, optionally cancelling callback invocation.

methods.name: BackendIO::IsEntryOperation
methods.description: Checks if the operation targets an entry.

methods.name: InFlightBackendIO::OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Opens or creates a cache entry.

methods.name: InFlightBackendIO::DoomEntriesBetween
methods.description: Deletes cache entries within a time range.

methods.name: InFlightBackendIO::WaitForPendingIO
methods.description: Blocks until all pending I/O operations are complete.
